note: Written before any Z3c parser code existed. Rule wordings disjoint from the Z3b dev templates. {v} = true value, {x} = decoy number (never a rule).

budget: We cannot pay more than {v} euros.
A ceiling of {v} euros applies to expenses.
Up to {v} euros may be used.
The client will cover no more than {v} euros.
deadline: Anything taking longer than {v} days is out.
It must not take more than {v} days.
A turnaround of at most {v} days is required.
{v} days is the longest acceptable duration.
The job needs to be completed in {v} days or less.
local_true: Options that are not local cannot be chosen.
We do not accept non-local options.
The option has to be a local one.
local_false: Local and non-local options are both acceptable.
We do not need a local option.
Non-local options may also be chosen.

deadline_local_true: It must be done within {d} days, and only local options count.
We need it in {d} days at most; remote options are not allowed.
deadline_local_false: It must be done within {d} days, but it does not have to be local.
We need it in {d} days at most; remote options are fine.
